title: Stelio Kontos
blurb: Dexter's Laboratory gave its most menacing character a theme so ludicrously over-the-top for a children's cartoon that the internet had no choice but to adopt it. Stelio Kontos exists purely to intimidate Dexter's father, and the music treats him like a mafia boss entering a restaurant — brass, swagger, and total unearned gravitas. It has become universal approach music: play it when somebody walks in with bad intentions and worse energy, or when you personally are entering a room where you are not wanted. The name alone is now a threat.
origin: The theme of Stelio Kontos from Dexter's Laboratory.
